title: On the twistor spaces of ALE gravitational instantons of type $A_{\rm odd}$
summary: We study the twistor spaces of toric ALE gravitational instantons of type $A_{2n-1}$ and the associated non-standard minitwistor spaces introduced by Hitchin. By analyzing the base locus of the linear system that induces the quotient meromorphic map from the compactified twistor space, we explicitly determine the images of certain distinguished twistor lines as hyperplane sections of the minitwistor space.
